semiconductor_relevance: High — Epicrew specializes in epitaxial growth equipment and related products, which are critical for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Epicrew develops and sells advanced epitaxial growth equipment, focusing on enhancing functionality and quality to improve productivity for semiconductor manufacturers. Their products include dual pyrometer systems for precise temperature measurement and correction, as well as solutions for upgrading existing epitaxial equipment.
capabilities: Aqua Twin Pro water scrubber technology

regional_presence.Taiwan: Epicrew is exhibiting jointly with Maxmold, a Taiwanese company that handles O-RINGs.
